mods.name: REVEX
mods.description: Graduated punishment system for PRAXIC AntiCheat. Tempbans, escalation, smart enforcement.

releases.notes:
> PRAXIC detects. REVEX punishes.

---

> 📉 **Graduated Escalation** — warn → tempban 15m → tempban 1h → tempban 1d → permanent ban. Fully configurable ladder. Per-check overrides supported.

> ⏱️ **Tempbans** — Duration format: `15m`, `1h`, `7d`, `perm`. Auto-unban on expiry. Disconnect screen shows remaining time.

> 🛡️ **Persistent Storage** — Bans and escalation steps survive server restarts. Expired bans cleaned automatically.

> 🔧 **Commands** — `/revex status`, `/revex bans`, `/revex ban <player> <duration>`, `/revex unban <player>`, `/revex reload`. All OP2+.

> 📢 **Staff Alerts** — OP2+ notified on every enforcement action.

> ♻️ **Auto Reset** — Players who stay clean for 24h (configurable) reset back to step 1.
